# IZEA

> > IZEA is an influencer marketing and content creation platform offering branded content solutions, influencer campaign management, and AI-powered tools like FormAI and IZEA Marketplace.

IZEA Worldwide, Inc. provides comprehensive influencer marketing services, content marketing optimization tools, and educational resources for brands and agencies. The platform specializes in B2B and B2C influencer campaigns, branded content creation, and social media marketing across platforms like Snapchat.

## Key Topics

- IZEA Marketplace
- FormAI
- Influencer Marketing
- Content Marketing Optimization
- Branded Content
- B2B Influencer Marketing
- Content Strategy
- Brand Strategy
- Marketing Guides
- Case Studies
- Content Seeding
- ShareWorthy Podcast
- Native Advertising
- Social Media Marketing

## Influencer Marketing Guides

- [A Guide to B2B Influencer Marketing Campaigns](https://izea.com/resources/b2b-influencer-marketing-campaigns): B2B influencer marketing guide with case studies and team building tips
- [Content Marketing Pricing: How To Get The Most Value For Your Money](https://izea.com/resources/content-marketing-pricing): Pricing guide for content marketing services and value optimization
- [Snapchat Influencer Marketing for Brands and Agencies](https://izea.com/resources/snapchat-influencer-marketing): Snapchat influencer marketing platform for brands and agencies
- [Branded Content Marketing: How Brands Can Use Branded Content](https://izea.com/resources/branded-content-marketing): Guide to branded content and native advertising strategy for brands

## Content Marketing Strategy

- [Content Marketing Optimization: An Introduction to Everything You Need to Know](https://izea.com/resources/content-marketing-optimization): Guide to content marketing optimization with IZEA Marketplace & FormAI
- [Approach B2B Content Marketing: How-To Get Started Off Right](https://izea.com/resources/approach-b2b-content-marketing): Getting started guide for B2B content marketing strategy with IZEA
- [Content Seeding: What It Is & How To Use It In Content Marketing Campaigns](https://izea.com/resources/content-seeding): Guide to content seeding strategy for marketing campaigns
- [Are You Missing Out on Revenue Because Your Content isn't Mobile Ready?](https://izea.com/resources/is-your-content-ready-for-mobile): Mobile optimization guide for content strategy and revenue growth
